summary: Preserve native-clamped product quantities in manufacturing carrier guards.
details: The canonical productive-output index and manufacturing matcher now share the native maximum base product quantity rule: a fixed amount wins over range fields, and a reversed maximum is clamped to the minimum.
A productive carrier return can no longer disappear because its authored ranged maximum is lower than its minimum. Covered carrier quantities still retain their existing productivity exclusion.

The consumed material-route fixture adds 56 assertions through the actual recipe normalizer, canonical risk classifier and manufacturing matcher for item and fluid products. All 258 controlled assertions pass.
This does not admit new material routes or establish extra-roll semantics, machine availability, profitable-loop behavior or native package qualification. Exact native proof remains pending.
